Package index

Core structure

The classes and generics that define how a sketch is built and rendered, independent of any specific drawable.

sketch()
A collection of drawable objects
drawable()
Parent class for all drawable objects
draw()
Draw a drawable or sketch
point_set()
A set of polygon vertices
style()
Graphical style for a drawable object

2D shapes

Closed, fillable drawables (geometry = "polygon").

shape_bezier()
A closed Bezier curve
shape_blob()
An irregular, "blobby" circle
shape_circle()
A circle
shape_raw()
A polygon defined directly by its vertices
shape_ribbon()
A tapered ribbon between two points
shape_twist()
A twisted ribbon following a random path

1D curves

Open, stroked drawables (geometry = "path").

curve_bezier()
An open Bezier curve
curve_line()
An open polyline
curve_raw()
An open path defined directly by its vertices
curve_scribble()
A wandering scribble curve
curve_spiral()
An open spiral

0D points

Unconnected marker drawables (geometry = "points").

points_raw()
A scatter of points defined directly by their coordinates

Fills

Textures and patterns for style()’s fill argument, used by 2D shapes.

fill_checker()
Checkerboard pattern fill
fill_crosshatch()
Crosshatch pattern fill
fill_flow()
Domain-warped noise texture fill
fill_gradient()
Gradient fill
fill_halftone()
Halftone dot pattern fill
fill_hatch()
Diagonal hatch pattern fill
fill_image()
User-supplied raster image fill
fill_marble()
Marbled, veined texture fill
fill_noise()
Simplex/fractal noise texture fill
fill_none()
Unfilled (transparent) fill
fill_scatter()
Scattered-shape pattern fill
fill_scribble()
Wandering-line scribble texture fill
fill_solid()
Solid colour fill
fill_stipple()
Stippled dot pattern fill
fill_stripe()
Striped pattern fill
fill_vignette()
Vignette fill
